name: Amplitude
summary: Product analytics from an Amplitude project: saved chart results, event segmentation, funnels, retention, active users, revenue LTV and a user's event stream.

host.description: amplitude.com for US projects, analytics.eu.amplitude.com for EU data residency.

api_key.description: the project's API key (Organization settings > Projects > the project), the Basic auth username

secret_key.description: the same project's secret key, the Basic auth password

notes: Keys belong to one project: every call reads that project only.
Dates are YYYYMMDD without dashes; times follow the project's time zone. Event and property names with spaces must be URL encoded (the client does this).

Limits: 5 concurrent requests per key. Queries also spend a per-project cost budget (1,000 concurrent, 108,000 per hour): cost = days x conditions x query-type cost, at least 10, with ranges under 7 days counted as 7. 429 when exceeded; honour Retry-After.

Events (e, e2, se, re) are JSON objects {event_type, filters, group_by}; filters are [{subprop_type: event|user, subprop_key, subprop_op, subprop_value: [..]}] with ops is, is not, contains, does not contain, less, greater, set is, ... Custom user properties take a gp: prefix.

endpoints.name: Get a saved chart's results
endpoints.summary: The results of a chart saved in Amplitude, by its id, as JSON.

chart_id.description: The chart id from the chart's URL.

notes: The answer's shape depends on the chart type, and follows the chart's current definition: edits to the chart change it.
A chart from another project answers 400; use that project's keys.

endpoints.name: Query event segmentation
endpoints.summary: Uniques, totals, DAU share, averages or a formula for up to two events over time, optionally grouped by properties.

e.description: The event: {event_type, filters?, group_by?}. Custom events take a ce: prefix; _active is any active event, _all any event, revenue_amount revenue.

e2.description: A second event, same shape, for two-event metrics and formulas.

m.description: Metric: uniques (default), totals, pct_dau, average; histogram, sums or value_avg (need a group_by in e); formula.

i.description: Interval: -300000 (real time, up to 2 days), -3600000 (hourly, up to 7 days), 1 (daily, default, up to 365 days), 7 (weekly) or 30 (monthly).

s.description: Segment definitions, a JSON array: property filters [{prop, op, values}] (prop 'userdata_cohort' with a cohort id filters to a cohort) or performed-event filters. Omit for all users.

g.description: Up to two group-by properties, each sent as its own g. gp: prefix for custom user properties.

limit.description: Group-by values returned: 1,000 by default, 20,000 at most.

formula.description: Required when m is formula, e.g. UNIQUES(A)/UNIQUES(B); A is e, B is e2.

endpoints.name: Query a funnel
endpoints.summary: Step-by-step and cumulative conversion with transition times for a sequence of events.

e.description: One event object per step, in order; each is sent as its own e.

mode.description: ordered (default), unordered, or sequential (no other events between steps).

i.description: Interval: -300000 (real time, up to 2 days), -3600000 (hourly, up to 7 days), 1 (daily, default, up to 365 days), 7 (weekly) or 30 (monthly).

s.description: Segment definitions, a JSON array: property filters [{prop, op, values}] (prop 'userdata_cohort' with a cohort id filters to a cohort) or performed-event filters. Omit for all users.

g.description: One property to group by: a built-in (country, platform, os, version, ...) or gp:<custom user property>. Only with a single segment.

cs.description: Conversion window in seconds; 2,592,000 (30 days) by default.

limit.description: Group-by values returned, at most 1,000 (the default).

endpoints.name: Query retention
endpoints.summary: N-day, unbounded or bracket retention from a start event to a return event.

se.description: Start event object; event_type _new (new users), _active, or any event.

re.description: Return event object; event_type _all, _active, or any event.

rb.description: Brackets, required with rm=bracket: [[start, end]] with end exclusive, e.g. [[0,5]] for day 0 to 4.

s.description: Segment definitions, a JSON array: property filters [{prop, op, values}] (prop 'userdata_cohort' with a cohort id filters to a cohort) or performed-event filters. Omit for all users.

g.description: One property to group by: a built-in (country, platform, os, version, ...) or gp:<custom user property>. Only with a single segment.

notes: In each value list, index 0 is the cohort size and index N+1 is retention N intervals out (index 1 is day 0). Dates come newest first.

endpoints.name: Count active or new users
endpoints.summary: Daily, weekly or monthly active or new user counts, optionally segmented and grouped.

s.description: Segment definitions, a JSON array: property filters [{prop, op, values}] (prop 'userdata_cohort' with a cohort id filters to a cohort) or performed-event filters. Omit for all users.

g.description: One property to group by: a built-in (country, platform, os, version, ...) or gp:<custom user property>. Only with a single segment.

endpoints.name: Break users down by a property
endpoints.summary: Unique users per value of one property (country, platform, a custom user property...).

p.description: The property: version, country, city, region, DMA, language, platform, os, device, start_version, paying, or gp:<custom user property>.

endpoints.name: Get average session length
endpoints.summary: Average session length per day, in seconds.

endpoints.name: Get revenue lifetime value
endpoints.summary: ARPU, ARPPU, total revenue or paying users by cohort day, with n-day values up to 90 days.

m.description: 0 ARPU (default), 1 ARPPU, 2 total revenue, 3 paying users.

s.description: Segment definitions, a JSON array: property filters [{prop, op, values}] (prop 'userdata_cohort' with a cohort id filters to a cohort) or performed-event filters. Omit for all users.

g.description: One property to group by: a built-in (country, platform, os, version, ...) or gp:<custom user property>. Only with a single segment.

endpoints.name: List event types
endpoints.summary: Every visible event type with this week's totals and its hidden or deleted flags.

endpoints.name: Find a user
endpoints.summary: Amplitude ids matching a user id, device id, Amplitude id or user id prefix.

user.description: An Amplitude id, device id, user id, or the start of a user id.

notes: No match is a 200 with type 'nomatch' and an empty matches list.
Shares a per-project budget with user activity: 10 concurrent and 360 per hour.

endpoints.name: Get a user's event stream
endpoints.summary: A user's events, newest or oldest first, and their profile summary.

user.description: The Amplitude id (find it with users.search).

offset.description: Events to skip from the start of the stream.

limit.description: Events to return, up to 1,000 (the default); may return a few more to keep sessions whole.

notes: Shares a per-project budget with user search: 10 concurrent and 360 per hour.
